verdict.rationale: Dots runs unattended in the cloud on its own computer, keeps working while your computer is off, and supports scheduled recurring runs, Slack-triggered work, and background agents, so it covers automation that needs no live UI. However, it is driven only through conversational surfaces (ChatGPT, Slack, Teams, calls). The runtime probe found no dots-specific public API, CLI, or other programmatic surface for invoking it from a CI pipeline. Missing for 10: a headless CLI or API invocation mode, CI pipeline integration (e.g., GitHub Actions), non-interactive auth for automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
